paragraphs.text: Guardian is an obsolete class for creatures that guard, protect, or preserve.

The first creature to bear the type was Guardian Beast from Antiquities . The subtype was obsoleted in the Grand Creature Type Update with its former creatures split among many other creature types often representing their species .
Other cards printed with the Guardians type include:
Harbor Guardian is now a Gargoyle .
Fountain Watch is now a Human Cleric .
Hydromorph Gull is now an Elemental Bird .
Spectral Guardian is now a Spirit .
Armored Guardian is now a Cat Soldier .
Hydromorph Guardian is now an Elemental.
Luminous Guardian is now a Human Nomad .
Sustaining Spirit is now an Angel Spirit.
Various characters also have Guardian as part of their name or epithet.
